skill.summary: Get polished training videos ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), say something...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Bootcamp: rapid AI-powered video editing for training/course creators.
- Upload raw video files (up to 500MB), describe desired edits (e.g. cut dead air, add chapters), and export polished 1080p MP4s.
- Automatic backend setup: handles session/token management, with 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports essential workflows: quick edits, batch processing, iterative refining, and common LMS exports.
- Guidance for error handling, supported formats, and maximizing processing speed included.
